recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒球系前驅細胞出現多種異常：一顆前骨髓細胞／骨髓細胞細胞質有多個清楚空泡，數顆骨髓細胞顆粒分佈不均、部分區域淡染無顆粒；右側一顆成熟顆粒球只有兩個圓形核葉相連（假性 Pelger-Huët，pince-nez 樣）。這些綜合起來是顆粒球生成異常（dysgranulopoiesis）。
features: Cluster of granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes and myelocytes) with uneven, patchy granulation and agranular cytoplasmic areas
Promyelocyte/myelocyte with multiple discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Mature granulocyte with a bilobed, pince-nez nucleus and hypogranular cytoplasm (pseudo-Pelger-Huët)
Some precursors with large nuclei showing nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
An elongated dense cell (likely a smeared/degenerating cell) and a hyposegmented neutrophil at the lower left
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of granulocytic precursors with dysplastic features. Several promyelocytes and myelocytes show uneven granulation with agranular cytoplasmic zones, and one contains multiple discrete clear vacuoles. A mature granulocyte displays a bilobed pince-nez nucleus with hypogranular cytoplasm, consistent with a pseudo-Pelger-Huët cell, and some precursors show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis; correlation with the proportion of dysplastic cells, blast count, cytogenetics and exclusion of reactive causes (drugs, alcohol, copper deficiency) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huët affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation, whereas pseudo-Pelger cells here coexist with hypogranularity and other dysplastic precursors.
Vacuolated myeloid and erythroid precursors can be seen with alcohol or copper deficiency; distinction requires clinical history, copper/zinc levels and absence of clonal abnormalities.
APL shows sheets of hypergranular abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles, rather than a maturing granulocytic series with scattered dysplasia.
